author: Taako
name: deepdelve
short: A living, persistent old-school text RPG for Discord.
description: A full-scale living-world Discord text RPG with a persistent hub, six-act campaign, branching quests, morality and Tenets, factions, relationships, named dungeons, a Nemesis system, professions, collections, permanent seasons, tactical combat, and optional Red bank integration.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-server Discord user IDs and persistent RPG profiles including character identity, origin choices and philosophy, living morality score, convictions, Tenets, Resolve sources, remembered deeds and consequence flags, faction reputation, quest journal and claims, relationships, gifts and favors, mailbox, Nemeses, Atlas and named-dungeon progress, Sanctum upgrades, Living Chronicle decisions and endings, permanent seasonal archive, commissions and recipe research, background, attributes, talents, subclass, statistics, inventory, stash, favorites, loadouts, equipment and enchantments, consumables, forge recipes, legendary and set discoveries, set fragments, codex and collection progress, currency cache, progression, encounters, floor conditions, hidden rooms, camps, rumors, bestiary mastery, run history, puzzle history, companions, profession mastery, gathering activity, town contributions, conditions, materials, contracts, reputation, NPC story progress, lore, journal entries, titles, scars, blessings, achievements, social memberships, arena records, endgame and seasonal progress. Guild configuration may also store user IDs in parties, auctions, player guilds, shared vaults, arena challenges, world-boss contributions, server-first records, and shared town contributors. When Red bank integration is enabled, the cog reads and changes the user's Red bank balance for game transactions. This data is used only for DeepDelve gameplay and is covered by Red's data export and deletion tools.
install_msg: DeepDelve awaits! Load the cog, then use `[p]deepdelve create` or `/deepdelve create` to begin. Administrators can use `[p]deepdelve set` to configure the game.
